mission.title: I Come in Peace
mission.description: Find out who commands the Unlimit in the field, starting with Phinney's old flame Strenlo.

npc.say: What's Phinney doin' sending a little pipsqueak like you here?

phase.briefing:
Since the attempt to synthesize a cheat code from vial residues was a remarkable failure--and I'd just like to point out that I said it was a foolish idea from the beginning--the Merovingian has decided that the best way to get a true sample of the cheat codes is to extract it from someone who's actually partaken of one.
We've learned from our contacts among the Machines that a certain Unlimit field commander by the name of "Phinney" has been conducting some Aqueduct sabotage. Apparently, she has a Zionite boyfriend named "Strenlo." I'm sending you to meet this star-crossed lover. Make it clear to him that it is in his best interests to tell us where Phinney can be found.

enter.say: I've got a redpill signal in there; should be Strenlo.

talk.say: Hah. I'll tell you what I told the Machinist who was just here asking the same questions: I haven't seen Phinney in weeks. She's crazy, and wants to kill me because I didn't fall for her like she did for me. Drinking that vial of Anome's probably didn't help clear her head. There's a certain scumbag informant we both know, Firewall--he'll probably know where to find her.

done.say: I don't really want to know. Just get out.

phase.briefing: Firewall is a well-known trafficker in petty information. He is easily found. If Phinney truly relies on such a creature, she may just be the sort of fool we're looking for.

enter.say: Picking up a powerful program signal in there. Firewall could be an Exile?

near.say: Uh-oh. Looks like those bastards got there before us.

talk.say: The individual in question met with a regrettable accident resisting arrest, {player}. As you can see, there is nothing more for you to learn here.

done.say: Bleepin' Agents! Flood isn't going to like this.
Thank you, {player}. We have the situation well in hand.

phase.briefing:
It is rather vexing that you failed to get there before the Machines did, operative. Remind me not to send you on any more time-critical missions. I think we can consider Phinney's potential usefulness at an end. Now you need to come up with a replacement. I suppose you'll just have to do this the hard way...
I'm sending you to a little nest of Unlimits that we've been watching. Infiltrate their hideout and obtain information leading to their commander, whoever that might be.

enter.say: Sooo... I guess you're gonna be using the tried-and-true "take me to your leader" routine here, eh?

near.say: Okay, the next door is locked. Think you can bluff your way in?
That one looks plenty self-important. Try talking to them.

objective.text: Talk to the Unlimit Reactor at the door

done.say: Yeah? You just better not be wasting our time. Go on in, and make it quick.
Full of themselves, as usual. Looks like they've opened up the far door for you, though.

objective.text: Get information on the Unlimit field commander

done.say: Phinney says she needs reinforcements? What the hell? She has more people than we do. Why did she send you here?

Uh, nice one...
The computer in there has an network uplink, but it looks like it requires a hard access code. Your uptight pal there's probably carrying it.
Search them for the access code!

objective.text: Get the Access Card from the Unlimit Reactor

done.say: Yep, that's it! Try it in the computer!

objective.text: Put the Access Card in the computer

done.say: All right, you should have access to that terminal now. Let's see if it can point us to their commander.

Hey, a connection to their email server. If we can get into that, we can find out all kinds of stuff. I think I can trace it... Yeah, trace is going through. Get out of there and I'll route it into your HUD program.

phase.briefing: Snooping through their email? I suppose that's right up your alley, {player}. Just try not to let yourself get distracted by the sordid details; remember, we're just looking for the identity of their field commander.

enter.say:
I've got more Unlimit signals than you can shake a stick at in there, and, let's see... Yup, there's their mail server.
Killing people and reading their email--now that's cold.
There's the mail server. It's access-restricted... If you can't hack it, you'll have to find the access code somewhere.

done.say: All right, you should have full access to that system now.
Hm... I think we've got enough. Let's let Flood know what we found.

mission.finish:
Mm hm... Not much there... Ah...
This "Beirn"... Could one of Anome's commanders really be obsessed with Persephone? I don't know what everyone sees in her blatant attempts to stay attractive... Well. If this is indeed the case, it could be used to our advantage. Beirn, eh...
